messages.summary:
## Objective
- Turn the existing chess survival game into a playable chess roguelike with levels and upgrades.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use three levels, each requiring survival through ten enemy turns.
- Offer one permanent recruit upgrade after levels 1 and 2; add enemy reinforcements on later levels.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated the game’s branding and level/recruit UI.
- Added three recruit choices, persistent recruits between levels, enemy reinforcements, and level completion flow in `index.html`.
- `node --check /tmp/game.js` and `git diff --check` completed without errors.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game and test board interactions, surviving a level, choosing an upgrade, and advancing to the next level.
2. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; address any visual or gameplay bugs.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation and all current changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`.
- Browser gameplay and screenshot checks have not yet been performed.

## Objective
- Turn the existing chess survival game into a playable chess roguelike with levels and upgrades.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Three levels, each requiring survival through ten enemy turns.
- Offer one permanent recruit upgrade after levels 1 and 2; add enemy reinforcements on later levels.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated the game’s branding, level and recruit UI, permanent recruit choices, enemy reinforcements, and level progression in `index.html`.
- Tested board interaction, level completion, upgrade choices, and advancing to levels 2 and 3 in a browser.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/level-3.jpg`.
- Renamed the page title to “Chess Roguelike.”
- `node --check /tmp/game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- (none)

- (none)

1. Review the final diff and decide whether to commit the uncommitted changes.

- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation.
- `screenshots/level-3.jpg`: Latest small JPEG browser check.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser checks confirmed level-up cards, recruit persistence, and level 3 enemy reinforcements.
